reviewNotes: Twenty-five shop-hours, fishing-broadcast, Lost and Found, Island Trader, island soundtrack, and special-item strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover time formatting, the F.I.B.S. name and joke, weather and water-type fragments, established island and character names, stylized parrot voice, canonical soundtrack locations, punctuation, and trailing spaces; both found no remaining objective issue.

Fishing_Channel_Intro.source: Thank you for tuning in to F.I.B.S., the Fishing Information Broadcast Service. Despite our unfortunate name, you can rest assured that we provide only the most trustworthy information about this season's fishing opportunities.
Fishing_Channel_Intro.translation: Vă mulțumim că urmăriți F.I.B.S., Serviciul de Difuzare a Informațiilor despre Pescuit. În ciuda numelui nostru nefericit, vă asigurăm că oferim numai informații de încredere despre posibilitățile de pescuit din acest anotimp.

TV_Fishing_Channel_Ocean.preservationReason: Ocean is spelled identically in Romanian and English.

NewLostAndFoundItems.source: Some items were placed in the town Lost and Found.
NewLostAndFoundItems.translation: Unele obiecte au fost puse în cutia cu „Obiecte pierdute și găsite” a orașului.

IslandTrader4_male.translation: Te rog, fă schimb cu mine, frate...

IslandTrader1.translation: Schimbă obiecte, te rog... Afacere bună!
